facts.text: The hotel is located along Victoria Harbour in the heart of Tsim Sha Tsui's business, shopping, cultural and entertainment district.
facts.excerpt: Located along Victoria Harbour, Sheraton Hong Kong Hotel & Towers is ideally situated in the heart of the city's business, shopping, cultural and entertainment district.

facts.text: The hotel is set on Nathan Road along Victoria Harbour.
facts.excerpt: Set on Nathan Road along bustling Victoria Harbour

facts.text: There is subway access right outside the hotel's doors.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy subway access right outside of our hotel's doors

facts.text: The hotel is within easy reach of the Hong Kong Museum of Art and the Cultural Centre.
facts.excerpt: Sheraton Hong Kong places guests within easy reach of the Hong Kong Museum of Art, Cultural Centre, luxury retail destinations, and major corporate offices.

facts.text: Sites near the hotel include the Avenue of Stars.
facts.excerpt: Beautiful sites near the hotel include Hong Kong Stadium, Avenue of Stars, Repulse Bay and Stanley Market.

facts.text: The outdoor, temperature-controlled rooftop pool is on Level 18, faces the harbour and has three heated Jacuzzis.
facts.excerpt: Our Level 18 floor outdoor temperature-controlled pool facing the harbor and three heated Jacuzzis let you relax in the fresh air all year round.

facts.text: The rooftop pool has a sundeck for sunbathing.
facts.excerpt: The sundeck provides a place to sunbathe.

facts.text: Many rooms and suites feature sweeping views of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline.
facts.excerpt: Many accommodations feature sweeping views of Victoria Harbour and the Hong Kong skyline

facts.text: Rooms and suites feature designer furnishings and floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in stylish rooms and suites featuring modern technology, designer furnishings, and floor-to-ceiling windows.

facts.text: Rooms offer the Sheraton Sleep Experience.
facts.excerpt: unique comforts like the Sheraton Sleep Experience

facts.text: The Sheraton Club is a private lounge area with a harbour view, for guests who value privacy and personal service.
facts.excerpt: A private area accompanied with the magnificent harbor view, Sheraton Club is for guests who put a premium on privacy and personal service

facts.text: The hotel offers a character-themed Family Room with Victoria Harbour views.
facts.excerpt: Treat your little ones to a character-themed Family Room in Kowloon Hong Kong with stunning Victoria Harbour views

facts.text: A jogging course runs adjacent to the hotel along the waterfront overlooking Victoria Harbour.
facts.excerpt: The jogging course is located adjacent to the hotel, along the waterfront overlooking Victoria Harbour.

facts.text: Oyster & Wine Bar serves freshly shucked oysters, premium wines and fine spirits against the backdrop of Victoria Harbour.
facts.excerpt: Discover an impressive selection of freshly shucked oysters, premium wines, and fine spirits, all set against the stunning backdrop of Victoria Harbour.

facts.text: Sky Lounge serves afternoon tea and is the hotel's restaurant with a view.
facts.excerpt: afternoon tea in our Sky Lounge, our Hong Kong restaurant with a view.

facts.text: Qibla direction is provided in all guest rooms, and a Quran and prayer mat are available on request.
facts.excerpt: Guests can enjoy in-room prayer amenities, including a Quran and prayer mat upon request, with Qibla direction provided in all guest rooms.

facts.text: The concierge team is available 24 hours a day.
facts.excerpt: Our Concierge team is ready to be of service 24 hours a day

facts.text: Rooms do not have a coffee or tea maker.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at Sheraton Hong Kong Hotel & Towers do not have a coffee/tea maker.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at Sheraton Hong Kong Hotel & Towers.

facts.text: Celestial Court is a MICHELIN-recommended Chinese restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Our MICHELIN-recommended Chinese restaurant in Victoria Harbour, Hong Kong offers an idyllic setting for a dim sum lunch

contradictions.note: p1 says six restaurants and lounges; the amenities list on p1 says 7 Restaurants

sources.excerpt: Savour a superb meal at one of our six restaurants and lounges
